nusmp.page.book_world_tree.dracaena_form: Dracaena Formation - roots of the world tree burst up in a ring 4.5 blocks wide where you aim (up to 24 blocks): up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, are lifted a little and slowed (Slowness IV, 3.5 seconds). The wiki names the spell without a description, so the ring is the mod's reading; Root Bind stays the single-target version.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.sapling_lance: Sapling Lance - a lance of living sapling wood flies up to 38 blocks and bursts 1.5 blocks wide: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes, and the sap mends you 1 health for each foe it hits.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.mana_root_sip: Mana Root Sip - a thin root drinks from the foe you look at (16 blocks): 7 base damage, and 2 percent of its magicules flow to you.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.mistilteinn_t: Mistilteinn Thorn Barrage - four homing thorns of Mistilteinn wood fan out from the page, together about 8.4 base damage (2.1 each), and each hit slows for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.branch_sweep: Branch Sweep - a great branch sweeps a wide cone 6 blocks long in front of you: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and a shove back.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.root_spring: Root Spring - roots spring you forward up to 8 blocks; up to 4 foes on the way take 7 base damage and are shoved aside.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.canopy_shelte: Canopy Shelter - a canopy of branches opens over you and up to 7 allied players within 6 blocks for 8 seconds: Resistance I and Absorption II.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.heartroot_men: Heartroot Mending - the sap of the heartroot mends you and allied players within 7 blocks for 15 percent of their maximum health (the healing decay of the law applies).
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.warding_root_: Warding Root Net - a net of roots closes 4 blocks wide at the point you aim at (24 blocks): up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, Slowness V and Weakness for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.living_root_w: Living Root Wall - mangrove roots knit a wall four blocks wide and three high 2.5 blocks in front of you for 8 seconds; it stops charges and shots.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.spirit_light_: Spirit Light Tree - a tree of shining branches ties you to your allies: for 5 seconds, every second you and up to 7 allied players within 8 blocks mend 4 percent of their health and keep Regeneration I and Speed I. The wiki's union spell shares magic through the tree; the sword half is not built, only the sharing.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.root_eruption: Great Root Eruption - great roots erupt round you in a ring 6 blocks wide: up to 8 foes take 16 base damage, are thrown up and slowed (Slowness IV, 3 seconds).
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.mana_drinking: Mana-Drinking Field - for 4 seconds a field of drinking roots pulses round you every second: up to 8 foes within 6 blocks take 5 base damage, are slowed and lose 1.5 percent of their magicules to you.
nusmp.page.book_world_tree.world_tree_aw: World Tree Awakening - the whole world tree wakes round you: for 5 seconds, every second up to 10 foes within 8 blocks take 7 base damage, are held in Slowness V and lose 2 percent of their magicules, while you and your allies mend 5 percent of your health and keep Regeneration II.
nusmp.page.book_poison.venom_needle_voll: Venom Needle Volley - four poison needles fan out from the page, together about 8.4 base damage (2.1 each); every hit poisons for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.blight_spit: Blight Spit - a glob of blight flies up to 38 blocks and bursts 1.5 blocks wide: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and Poison II for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.badger_burrow: Poison Badger Burrow - in the manner of Aufwachen Dachs a poison badger tunnels you forward up to 7 blocks; up to 4 foes on the way take 7 base damage and Poison I for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.withering_touch: Withering Touch - a close cone of rotting breath 3.5 blocks long: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and Wither I for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.miasma_mantle: Miasma Mantle - for 10 seconds a mantle of miasma clings to you: Resistance I, 6 extra base damage on your melee blows, and whoever strikes you is pricked for 2.
nusmp.page.book_poison.antidote_draught: Antidote Draught - a poisoner knows the cure: you and up to 7 allied players within 6 blocks lose every harmful effect, mend 10 percent of their health and keep Regeneration I for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.paralytic_sting: Paralytic Sting - one foe within 14 blocks is stung and held (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock, short on players and bosses): 6 base damage and Poison II.
nusmp.page.book_poison.poison_fog_bomb: Poison Fog Bomb - a bomb of poison fog bursts 4 blocks wide at the point you aim at (24 blocks): up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, Poison II and Blindness for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.venom_rain: Venom Rain - a rain of venom falls 5 blocks wide at the point you aim at for 4 seconds: every second up to 8 foes take 5 base damage and Poison II.
nusmp.page.book_poison.pestilence_stream: Pestilence Stream - a stream of plague breath runs 14 blocks along your sight, 2.5 wide: up to 8 foes take 16 base damage, Poison II and Weakness for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison.deluge_of_venom: Deluge of Venom - a flood of venom pours over the point you aim at (20 blocks) for 5 seconds: every second up to 10 foes within 8 blocks take 7 base damage, Poison II and Weakness.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.cotton_ball_toss: Cotton Ball Toss - a fist of cotton is tossed up to 38 blocks and bursts 1.5 blocks wide: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and a soft shove.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.lamb_charge: Lamb Charge - a woolly lamb carries you forward up to 8 blocks; up to 4 foes on the way take 7 base damage and are knocked aside.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.wool_volley: Wool Volley - five homing tufts of wool, together about 8.4 base damage (1.7 each); every hit slows for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.cotton_spring: Cotton Spring - a sheep of cotton springs you about 6 blocks forward and up, and you drift down softly (slow falling for 2 seconds); no fall damage.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.cotton_candy_snac: Cotton Candy Snack - a sweet puff of spun cotton: you and up to 7 allied players within 4 blocks mend 6 percent of their health and are fed.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.wool_wall: Wool Wall - a wall of fluffy wool four blocks wide and three high rises 2.5 blocks in front of you for 8 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.drowsy_wool_mist: Drowsy Wool Mist - a mist of drifting wool fluff settles 4 blocks wide at the point you aim at (24 blocks): up to 6 foes take 12 base damage and grow drowsy (Slowness IV and Weakness II for 5 seconds).
nusmp.page.book_cotton.warm_wool_blanket: Warm Wool Blanket - a warm blanket of wool wraps you and up to 7 allied players within 6 blocks: 8 percent of their health mended, Regeneration I for 5 seconds and Absorption I for 10.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.sheep_stampede: Sheep Stampede - a flock of cotton sheep thunders 14 blocks along your sight, 3 wide: up to 8 foes take 16 base damage, are thrown back and slowed for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_cotton.cotton_meadow: Cotton Meadow - a meadow of soft cotton spreads 6 blocks wide at the point you aim at for 5 seconds: every second you and your allies there mend 4 percent and keep Regeneration I, while foes sink in it (Slowness III).
nusmp.page.book_cotton.sleepy_sheep_para: Sleepy Sheep Parade - five great sheep march out of the page and home in on the foes: together about 31 base damage (6.2 each), and every hit leaves Slowness V for 4 seconds and Weakness II for 5.
nusmp.page.book_plant.magic_flower_bulle: Magic Flower Bullet - a small bud of mana is fired up to 38 blocks and blooms 1 block wide where it lands: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes. The small cousin of the Magic Flower Cannon; the effect is the mod's reading.
nusmp.page.book_plant.pollen_puff: Pollen Puff - a cloud of pollen puffs out in a cone 5 blocks long: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes, Weakness for 4 seconds and Slowness II for 3.
nusmp.page.book_plant.bloom_leap: Bloom Leap - a flower bursts under your feet and flings you about 6 blocks forward and up; when you land the petals burst 3.5 blocks wide for 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and a short slow.
nusmp.page.book_plant.sunflower_beam: Sunflower Beam - a sunflower turns its face and fires a beam of light 16 blocks along your sight: 12 base damage to up to 6 foes, who also glow for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_plant.wisteria_ward: Wisteria Ward - hanging wisteria shields you and up to 7 allied players within 5 blocks: Absorption II for 10 seconds and Resistance I for 5.
nusmp.page.book_plant.lullaby_blossom: Lullaby Blossom - a blossom sings one foe within 16 blocks into a stupor (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock, short on players and bosses): 6 base damage and Weakness II.
nusmp.page.book_plant.princess_healing_f: Princess Healing Flower Garden - a garden of healing flowers blooms round you for 5 seconds: every second you and up to 7 allied players within 7 blocks mend 5 percent of their health and keep Regeneration I. The lesser sister of Flower Princess Utopia; the effect is the mod's reading.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.petal_bur: Petal Burst - the petals round you burst outward 3.5 blocks: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and a shove back.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.blossom_s: Blossom Spring - a gust of blossoms springs you about 5 blocks forward and up and lets you drift down softly (slow falling for 2 seconds); no fall damage.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.sakura_la: Sakura Lance - petals braid into a lance that runs 16 blocks along your sight: 12 base damage to up to 6 foes and Blindness for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.petal_cyc: Petal Cyclone - a cyclone of petals whirls round you, 5 blocks wide: up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, are blinded for 2.5 seconds and thrown back.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.scent_of_: Scent of Spring - the scent of spring blossoms lifts you and up to 7 allied players within 6 blocks: 8 percent of their health mended, Speed II and Regeneration I for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_cherry_blossom.falling_p: Falling Petal Rain - petals fall like rain 6 blocks wide at the point you aim at for 4 seconds: every second up to 8 foes take 5 base damage and Blindness for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_briar.thorn_spike_row: Thorn Spike Row - a row of thorned briars shoots up along the ground 10 blocks ahead: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and Poison I for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_briar.thorn_javelin: Thorn Javelin - a javelin of braided thorns flies up to 38 blocks and pricks the first foe it meets: 7 base damage and Poison I for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_briar.bramble_cage: Bramble Cage - brambles close round one foe within 16 blocks (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock, short on players and bosses): 6 base damage and Poison I.
nusmp.page.book_briar.briar_whirl: Briar Whirl - briars whirl out from you in a ring 4.5 blocks wide: up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, are thrown back and poisoned for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_briar.healing_rose: Healing Rose - a rose blooms at your feet: you and up to 7 allied players within 5 blocks lose every harmful effect, mend 10 percent of their health and keep Regeneration I for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_briar.wild_rose_thicket: Wild Rose Thicket - a thicket of wild roses fills 6 blocks at the point you aim at for 5 seconds: every second up to 8 foes take 5 base damage, Poison I and Slowness III.
nusmp.page.book_tree.acorn_barrage: Acorn Barrage - four hard acorns fan out from the page, together about 8.4 base damage (2.1 each), each with a small knock back.
nusmp.page.book_tree.branch_snap: Branch Snap - a branch snaps across a cone 5 blocks long: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and a shove back.
nusmp.page.book_tree.sap_trap: Sap Trap - sticky sap glues one foe within 16 blocks in place (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock, short on players and bosses): 6 base damage and Weakness.
nusmp.page.book_tree.rooted_stance: Rooted Stance - for 10 seconds you stand like an old trunk: Resistance II, 6 extra base damage on your melee blows, and whoever strikes you is pricked for 2.
nusmp.page.book_tree.whirling_leaf_storm: Whirling Leaf Storm - a storm of leaves whirls round you for 5 seconds: every second up to 8 foes within 6 blocks take 5 base damage, Blindness and Slowness II.
nusmp.page.book_vine.hooking_vine: Hooking Vine - a hooked vine snags the foes at the point you aim at (16 blocks, 2.5 blocks wide) and hauls them toward you: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes.
nusmp.page.book_vine.thrashing_vines: Thrashing Vines - vines thrash across a cone 5 blocks long: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and Slowness II for 2 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_vine.vine_whirl: Vine Whirl - vines whirl out from you in a ring 4.5 blocks wide: up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, are thrown back and slowed for 2.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_vine.sapping_vine: Sapping Vine - a vine shoots up to 38 blocks and bursts 2 blocks wide: 12 base damage to up to 6 foes, and it feeds you 2 health for each foe it hits.
nusmp.page.book_vine.creeping_overgrowth: Creeping Overgrowth - the ground at the point you aim at is overgrown for 5 seconds: every second up to 8 foes within 6 blocks take 5 base damage and Slowness IV.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.nightshade_: Nightshade Dart - a dart tipped with nightshade flies up to 38 blocks and pricks the first foe it meets: 7 base damage and Poison II for 5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.stinging_ne: Stinging Nettle Whip - a whip of stinging nettle runs 8 blocks along your sight: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes, Poison I for 3 seconds and Slowness II for 2.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.venom_pod_b: Venom Pod Burst - a venom pod bursts 3.5 blocks wide at the point you aim at (24 blocks): up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, Poison II for 5 seconds and Wither I for 2.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.foxglove_se: Foxglove Seize - foxglove closes round one foe within 14 blocks and slows its heart (hard control, shares the 12 second control lock, short on players and bosses): 6 base damage and Poison II.
nusmp.page.book_poison_plant.hemlock_haz: Hemlock Haze - a haze of hemlock spores hangs 6 blocks wide at the point you aim at for 5 seconds: every second up to 8 foes take 5 base damage, Poison II and Blindness.
nusmp.page.book_beast.tiger_pounce: Tiger Pounce - the legs coil like a tiger's and you pounce about 7 blocks forward; where you land, up to 4 foes within 3.5 blocks take 7 base damage and a short slow.
nusmp.page.book_beast.hawk_eye: Hawk Eye - the eyes sharpen like a hawk's: up to 4 foes within 14 blocks glow for 8 seconds, so they can be seen through cover.
nusmp.page.book_beast.holy_hunting: Holy Hunting - the hunt: you flash up to 12 blocks to the foe you look at (16 blocks) and land behind it, hitting everything on the way for 12 base damage (up to 6 foes) and marking them with Glowing for 5 seconds. Needs a target.
nusmp.page.book_beast.bogeyman: Bogeyman - a monstrous shape looms round you, 5 blocks wide: up to 6 foes take 12 base damage, are blinded for 3 seconds and left in Weakness II for 5.
nusmp.page.book_beast.holy_howling: Holy Howling - a howl rolls out in a wide cone 10 blocks long: up to 8 foes take 16 base damage, are thrown back hard and weakened for 5 seconds. Yrul's howl calls a dragon in the manga; the mod keeps the shock wave.
nusmp.page.book_body.shoulder_tackle: Shoulder Tackle - you drive forward up to 6 blocks with a shoulder; up to 4 foes on the way take 7 base damage and are thrown aside.
nusmp.page.book_body.pressure_point_jab: Pressure Point Jab - a finger into the right spot on the foe you look at (5 blocks): 7 base damage and Weakness for 4 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_body.adrenaline_surge: Adrenaline Surge - the body floods itself with adrenaline: for 8 seconds you gain Speed II, Strength I and Jump Boost I.
nusmp.page.book_body.second_wind: Second Wind - the body finds a second wind: you and up to 7 allied players within 4 blocks lose every harmful effect and mend 15 percent of their health (the healing decay of the law applies).
nusmp.page.book_body.titan_shockwave: Titan Shockwave - you slam both fists down and a shock wave runs out 6 blocks: up to 8 foes take 16 base damage and are thrown up and back.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.mushroom_cap_boun: Mushroom Cap Bounce - a giant cap sprouts under your feet and bounces you about 5 blocks forward and up; where you land the spores burst 3.5 blocks wide for 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and Poison I.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.puffball_barrage: Puffball Barrage - five homing puffballs burst on the foes, together about 14 base damage (2.9 each); every hit poisons for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_fungus.deathcap_garden: Deathcap Garden - a garden of deathcaps springs up 5 blocks wide at the point you aim at for 5 seconds: every second up to 8 foes take 5 base damage, Poison II and Weakness.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.chimera_tail: Chimera Tail Lash - the chimera's serpent tail lashes 7 blocks along your sight: 7 base damage to up to 4 foes and Weakness for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.cerberus_tri: Cerberus Triple Bite - three spectral heads of Cerberus snap at the nearest foes, together about 14 base damage (4.8 each); each bite mends you 1 health.
nusmp.page.book_demon_beast.underworld_s: Underworld Stampede - a stampede of underworld beasts thunders 14 blocks along your sight, 3 wide: up to 8 foes take 16 base damage, are thrown back and weakened (Weakness II, 4 seconds).
